design: Exact native residual expansion at L13 attention input into embedding/skip injection plus L0..12 attention and MLP outputs, with learned residual multipliers. Project through L13H0 Q2/K2 weights and observed native RMS denominators into frozen H742 rank4 coordinates. Pairwise binding/copy differences are decomposed without fitting. Attribution shares use sum dot(component_difference,total_difference)/sum squared total_difference; can be negative or >1. All H747 cells, native competence carried forward.
limitations: Native-state algebraic attribution with context-specific RMS factors, not causal mediation. Earlier outputs include their upstream dependencies, so a large direct contribution need not be earliest origin.
